purpose: Reproducibility campaign for the prospective 24-node candidate model. This amendment fixes implementation choices and the interpretation of the historical metric without changing the original preregistration file.

topology.normalization: divide all matrix entries by the global mean weighted degree sum(A_ij)/N; preserve symmetry

model.natural_frequencies: numpy.random.default_rng(seed).normal(1.0, 0.1, 24), using a separate Generator initialized with the same seed

primary_campaign.primary_metric: arithmetic mean of the final 100 post-update r samples; at dt=0.1 these are timestamps 490.1 through 500.0 inclusive
primary_campaign.criterion_interpretation: Use r_mean_last_100 for all three K values, matching the executable historical metrics.py implementation. The original JSON's shorthand r for K=0.5 and K=0.85 is explicitly resolved by this amendment.
primary_campaign.aggregation: Report every seed-level value and pass/fail; for each K report pass count, proportion, Wilson 95% interval, mean, sample standard deviation, median, minimum, and maximum. Do not pool K values. No all-seeds pass threshold or single campaign-wide binary success label is defined.

numerical_robustness.comparison_metric: trapezoidal time average of r over [490.1, 500.0], using linear interpolation at window boundaries
numerical_robustness.report: For each seed and K, report values at all three dt and absolute differences from dt=0.1. Summarize differences by K.
numerical_robustness.interpretation: Descriptive numerical sensitivity only. No numerical convergence claim or pass/fail tolerance is asserted by this campaign.

failure_policy.non_finite_state_or_metric: invalid run; stop campaign; preserve partial artifacts; do not replace seed
failure_policy.model_exception: invalid run; stop campaign; preserve partial artifacts; do not replace seed
failure_policy.infrastructure_failure: retry only the same frozen commit, seed, K, dt and parameters; retain attempt records
failure_policy.post_freeze_code_or_parameter_change: prohibited for this campaign; requires a new amendment and new campaign identifier

environment.source_identity: full Git commit SHA plus SHA-256 of model, campaign runner, protocol JSON and dependency lock

claims_boundary: This tests reproducibility and behavior of the specified computational model only.
It does not establish that the historical Antikythera mechanism operated as a Kuramoto network.
It does not establish emergence, synergy, physical causation or external validity.
The synthetic group-to-cycle mapping, equal amplitudes and global normalization are prospective modeling decisions, not archaeological findings.
The campaign is not evidence of numerical convergence.
